align_bpe_to_words: align GPT-2 BPE tokens to spaCy word tokens using a RoBERTa instance
align_features_to_words: align RoBERTa BPE-level features to word-level features using a token alignment map
spacy_nlp: create a spaCy English NLP pipeline instance for tokenization and parsing
spacy_tokenizer: create a spaCy tokenizer from the default English NLP pipeline
review_alignment_utils: review the RoBERTa alignment utilities for BPE to word token alignment
